claims.text: The SGD 6.00 no-show fee is chargeable only if all four POL-NS-01 limbs hold together, and limb (b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event. The only trace for this trip, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING: its payload is null, its admissibility status is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its weight_multiplier is 0.0, so under POL-GEN-02 it can carry no fact while its absence is itself citable. There is accordingly not one fix putting the car inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius for the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay, and the driver's own counterparty statement ('the GPS export is unavailable') concedes the gap. Limb (b) is not carried, and the charge fails.

POL-NS-02 deems the driver to have arrived only where the gps_trace contains at least three consecutive fixes, each accurate to 25 m or better, inside the arrival radius (150 m for a TRANSPORT_HUB such as this bay). EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0), so it supplies zero qualifying fixes and the 15 minutes preceding the 21:15:40 cancellation contain no qualifying in-radius fix at all. On the clause's own terms the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

Limb (c) measures the 300 second minimum dwell for a TRANSPORT_HUB from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, expressly not from the driver's 'arrived' tap at 21:10:20. With EV-GPS-09109 MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0) there is no qualifying fix and therefore no in-geofence interval to measure; the 5.3 minute wait_time_min in the trip record is telemetry of the arrival marker, not the GPS-verified dwell the clause demands. Limb (c) is not established either, so the fee fails independently of limb (b).

The fare_breakdown itemises the cancellation fee at exactly SGD 6.00, the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class figure, which is the greater of the SGD 6.00 zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, with payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The whole SGD 6.00 is therefore the sum at stake, and the correct rider outcome on this fee is a FULL_REFUND of the entire contested amount rather than any partial measure.

If the Judge instead reads a MISSING trace as leaving the arrival test unrunnable rather than failed, the fee still must not be collected: the sole evidence bearing on the driver's position during the waiting window is EV-GPS-09109, which is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so any finding resting on it cannot exceed that weight and cannot reach the 0.70 confidence floor. Escalation under POL-NS-09 holds the disputed SGD 6.00 rather than collecting it, and an escalated fee is not collected, so on either reading the rider is left not carrying the charge.

claims.text: The trip record carries three of the four limbs of the baseline charge under POL-NS-01: limb (a) is met by the driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-09T21:10:20; limb (d) is met because the trip was terminated by the driver at 21:15:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes that limb recognises; and the arrival-to-cancellation interval of 320 seconds (wait_time_min 5.3) stands above the 300-second minimum dwell for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup. I do not overstate limb (c): its strict measure runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, which cannot be computed because no GPS export exists, and 320 seconds is the best interval the record supports.

The driver's account is corroborated by the complete chat log, and the rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 is closed: the driver posted 'I am at the private-hire bay' at 21:10:40, twenty seconds after the arrival event, and when the rider wrote 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car' at 21:11:30 the driver replied 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45 — fifteen seconds later, well inside POL-NS-04's 120-second window — so limb (b) of that clause fails and the clause does not apply regardless of the reply's content.

POL-NS-05's false-arrival test cannot be run against the driver, and the rider carries the burden of it: the test matches the arrival timestamp to a GPS fix, and the only GPS artifact, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0. I disclose that impairment; no admissible fix places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or above, and a trace that does not exist cannot itself prove a false marker.

The rider's central assertion — 'the car was not at the pickup bay' — rests on nothing admissible: the only artifact that could place the driver outside the geofence is the GPS trace, and EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0). Under POL-GEN-02 a MISSING artifact can carry no fact and its absence is itself citable; absence of a trace is not evidence of absence, so on this record the rider has not proved non-arrival at all.

POL-NS-06 establishes no waiting-period shortfall: the effective in-geofence dwell cannot be computed because EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING (MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), and the trip record's own 320-second arrival-to-cancellation interval clears the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is also MISSING (MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0). I disclose both impairments; the absent advisory additionally means no kerb restriction, closure or enforcement on the pickup road is recorded, so nothing in the record cuts the dwell down.

The charged fee is exactly the fee the schedule prescribes, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises to discount it: fee_schedule.resolution_rule makes the chargeable amount the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) — SGD 6.00 — and the fare_breakdown cancellation_fee line is SGD 6.00. The fare artifact is complete at weight 1.0 and cannot be used to impair the charge.

If the charge stands the driver is owed compensation, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not bite: it requires BOTH limbs and neither trips — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008, far below 0.08 — so the driver is entitled to 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, SGD 4.80, the figure the fare breakdown's own derived driver_compensation publishes.

No repeat-abuse escalation trigger in POL-NS-09 fires on these profiles: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 where limb (d) needs 3 or more, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0 where limb (c) needs 2 or more disputes between the same pair. I cite only those named counters; the lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags on both profiles are context only under POL-GEN-01 and I do not rely on them.

On a rider-filed dispute, declining to act is a driver outcome: the fare breakdown shows payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION disposition leaves the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee standing in full rather than reversing it.

In the alternative, even if the absent GPS trace were treated as decisive against POL-NS-01 limb (b), the record still could not yield the refund the rider seeks: the deciding fact would be carried solely by EV-GPS-09109 at weight 0.0 (MISSING_ARTIFACT), POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at that weight, the 0.70 floor is breached, and POL-NS-09(a) and (e) then require ESCALATE — under which the disputed SGD 6.00 is held rather than collected or refunded. The fee is not returned on any reading of this record.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you: this case goes to a human reviewer, and the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is held — neither collected nor refunded — until that review is done.

What the record shows is not in dispute. The trip record (EV-TRIP-09109, weight 1.0) shows the driver marked 'arrived' at 21:10:20 on 9 Sep, the trip was then cancelled by the driver at 21:15:40 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, an interval of 5.3 minutes. The chat log (EV-CHAT-09109, weight 1.0) shows the driver writing 'I am at the private-hire bay' at 21:10:40 and 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45, and the rider writing 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car' at 21:11:30. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-09109, weight 1.0) shows a cancellation fee of SGD 6.00, and that arithmetic is correct: it is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), with payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

The difficulty is that the one thing that could settle the dispute is not in the file. A no-show fee stands only if all four POL-NS-01 limbs hold, and two of them are about the driver's GPS position: limb (b) needs the GPS trace to put the driver inside the 150 m arrival radius at the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay at or before 21:10:20, and limb (c) measures the 300-second continuous dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, expressly not from the arrival tap. The only GPS artifact, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING — no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — and the driver's own statement concedes 'the GPS export is unavailable.'

That absence cuts both ways, which is why no monetary ruling issues. A trace that does not exist is not a trace showing the driver was elsewhere, so I do not accept the rider's argument that the fee must be refunded in full: the absence of readings is the limiting case of an impaired stretch, and POL-NS-02 itself treats a trace too sparse to establish the required readings as impaired under POL-NS-08(b) rather than as proof the driver never arrived. Limbs (b) and (c) are accordingly undecided — they support neither the fee (which needs them to hold) nor the refund (which needs them to fail). Equally, the driver's request for SGD 4.80 compensation under POL-NS-07 is refused because that clause pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not; the anti-farming check (no_show_terminations_30d of 1, and 1 ÷ 120 = 0.008) is not the reason it fails.

The rider's POL-NS-04 route does not open, and the driver is right on that point: the driver answered the rider's 21:11:30 message at 21:11:45, fifteen seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, so limb (b) of that clause fails irrespective of the reply's content. The false-arrival test (POL-NS-05) and the waiting-period shortfall test (POL-NS-06) cannot be run either, both needing the GPS fixes that do not exist, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is likewise MISSING. No fare defect arises to discount the charge (POL-NS-08(d)).

Because the only evidence that could carry the deciding fact is the missing GPS trace at weight 0.0, POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(e) send this to a human reviewer, and POL-NS-09(a) is met as well, since this record can support no confidence at or above the 0.70 floor. Escalation is terminal, so no money moves and no referral issues — no clause directs one here: POL-NS-05(ii)'s false-arrival record needs a trace showing no qualifying fix, which cannot be shown where no trace exists, and POL-NS-07's instruction to refund the fee applies only when its anti-farming test trips, which it does not. The open question for the reviewer, and it belongs in the explanation rather than a referral, is whether the driver was in fact inside the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay from 21:10:20 and held position there for the full 300 seconds; the disputed SGD 6.00 stays on hold while that is settled.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this case goes to a human reviewer, so the disputed SGD 6.00 no-show fee is HELD — not collected from the rider and not refunded — while review is pending. No money moves now.

Why. The one artifact that could decide whether the driver reached the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay is the GPS trace EV-GPS-09109, and it is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0). The trip record EV-TRIP-09109 and the chat log EV-CHAT-09109 are complete at weight 1.0, but POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test all read the GPS trace. The driver's 'arrived' tap at 21:10:20 and his messages ('I am at the private-hire bay' at 21:10:40, 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45) are things a party set or said — they record only that he set or said them, and they cannot stand in where the test admitted no reading at all. Because no GPS reading was admitted for the waiting window, the arrival and dwell questions are UNDECIDED, and an undecided limb supports neither the fee nor a refund. This is the case POL-NS-08 (last sentence) and POL-NS-09(e) send to a reviewer, since the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(b) (a trace with fewer than six fixes across the window).

Rider's claims, answered. I do not accept that the missing trace means 'no qualifying in-radius fix' and therefore a full refund of the SGD 6.00. POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-08(b) treat an absent or too-sparse trace as UNdecidable, expressly 'rather than proof of absence'; limb (b) is undecided, not failed. The same answer disposes of the limb (c) argument and the request for a full refund under POL-GEN-03/POL-NS-02. The rider's alternative that the case must escalate is accepted — that is this ruling — but escalation holds the fee, it does not return it.

Driver's claims, answered. The fee cannot be affirmed either: because limbs (b) and (c) cannot be run, POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, so the SGD 6.00 does not stand on this record and the SGD 4.80 driver compensation (80 percent of the fee) is not payable. The fee figure reconciles with the schedule — SGD 6.00, the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) — so no POL-NS-08(d) defect arises; fare_breakdown shows payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1/120 is far below 0.08), but that is moot. NO_ACTION is not available: it requires the present state to stand on a fee whose limbs are verified, which they are not. ruling.explanation:
The disputed charge is the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee on trip TRP-09109 (fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee 6.00 — the greater, per fee_schedule.resolution_rule, of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00). This charge cannot be decided automatically. It goes to a human reviewer and the SGD 6.00 is held — not collected and not refunded — while that review is pending.

Why the charge is undecided. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold together. Limbs (a) and (d) are satisfied on the trip record: there is a driver 'arrived' event at 21:10:20, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 21:15:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. But limbs (b) and (c) both read the GPS trace, and the only trace for this trip, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING (no payload; issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; weight_multiplier 0.0). POL-NS-01 limb (c) measures the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and expressly NOT from the 'arrived' tap, and POL-NS-02 requires at least three consecutive in-radius fixes accurate to 25 m or better. With no trace at all the arrival test could not be run. The 5.3-minute arrival-to-cancellation interval in the trip record is not a substitute — it is telemetry of the marker, not the GPS-verified dwell the clause demands, and the driver's chat assertions ('I am at the private-hire bay', 'I am here beside the sign') are the party's own account, not the clause's test.

Both parties' central claims are therefore rejected on this record. The rider's argument that a MISSING trace equals 'no qualifying in-radius fix' under POL-NS-02 is not accepted: absence of a trace is not a reading that ran and found nothing, so it is not a failed arrival test giving a full refund. The driver's counterparty statement ('I was at the bay for the full waiting period, but the GPS export is unavailable') concedes the gap but cannot fill it — it is self-serving, not an admission against interest, and it is not a contemporaneous record made from inside the disputed window, so it is not an independent carrier. Equally, the driver's argument that the charge should simply stand is not accepted: an undecided limb cannot carry the charge any more than it can carry the refund. On an undecided limb neither a money ruling for the rider nor a standing charge for the driver is available.

Escalation. POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact. The deciding fact here is whether the driver was inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius at the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay and held the required dwell; the only artifact that could carry it is EV-GPS-09109, at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. That cap is below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) requires escalation, and the same missing trace — the sole evidence for the deciding fact, impaired as a trace defect under POL-NS-08(b) — points the same way under POL-NS-09(e). As POL-GEN-02(3) requires, the impairment is named: EV-GPS-09109, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, and the finding does not survive the discount. No referral is produced: the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 is below 4, and 1 ÷ completed_trips_30d 120 = 0.008 is below 0.08), so no compensation is ordered and no escalation instruction is directed into the packet; POL-NS-05(ii) is unavailable because the false-arrival test cannot be run; and no POL-NS-09(c) or (d) profile trigger fires (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0; no_show_disputes_30d is 0). The lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags on both profiles are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used. Also noted and not decisive: EV-ADVIS-09109-01 (traffic advisory) is MISSING at weight 0.0, so the POL-NS-06(i) kerb-restriction route for summing separate in-geofence intervals is unavailable.

Open question for the human reviewer: whether the driver was actually within the 150 m arrival radius at this TRANSPORT_HUB bay for a continuous 300 seconds before cancelling. That can only be settled from the driver-device or platform GPS export for the waiting window (21:10:20 to 21:15:40 on 2026-09-09), which should be obtained before the SGD 6.00 is released or refunded.

Ruling: ESCALATE. The SGD 6.00 no-show fee on trip TRP-09109 is placed on hold — neither collected nor refunded — while a human reviewer settles the one fact this record cannot settle: whether the driver was inside the 150 m Woodlands MRT private-hire-bay geofence for the required 300-second dwell.

Why the charge can be neither confirmed nor rejected here. POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold. Two are clear from the trip record: the driver's 'arrived' event at 21:10:20 (limb (a)), and the driver's termination at 21:15:40 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. The two limbs that decide this case cannot be tested. Limb (b) is the GPS proximity test of POL-NS-02: at least three consecutive fixes, accurate to 25 m or better, inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius. Limb (c) is the 300-second dwell, measured — as the clause insists — from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's arrival tap at 21:10:20. Both read EV-GPS-09109, which is MISSING: payload null, status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0. Absence is the limiting case of impairment, so limbs (b) and (c) are UNDECIDED across the whole waiting window, not failed. The 5.3-minute wait_time_min in the trip record is telemetry of the driver's own arrival tap, and a status a party sets establishes only that the party set it.

Rider Advocate. Your reading of POL-NS-02 — that a trace with no qualifying in-radius fix means the driver never arrived and the whole SGD 6.00 must be refunded — would be right if the trace existed and merely showed no in-geofence fix; a test that runs and finds nothing has run. But the trace does not exist, so the test admitted no reading at all, and its absence cannot be pressed into proof of non-arrival any more than it proves arrival. Your alternative — that the deciding fact rests solely on a weight-0.0 artifact, so confidence cannot reach the floor and POL-NS-09 requires escalation — is the outcome I reach, and the SGD 6.00 will not be collected from you pending review.

Driver Advocate. Limbs (a) and (d) of POL-NS-01 are accepted from the trip record. I do not accept that the 320-second arrival-to-cancellation interval satisfies limb (c): it runs from the tap, not from a qualifying GPS fix, and the clause is explicit. Your SGD 4.80 compensation claim under POL-NS-07 therefore fails, because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full; the anti-farming check (no_show_terminations_30d 1, against a threshold of 4, and 1/120 against 0.08) never bites and is moot. Your contemporaneous account in the chat log and the counterparty statement does not rescue the fee either: where the test admitted no reading at all, an account offered in its place stands in for the test — it neither lifts the POL-GEN-02(2) cap nor stops the impaired artifact being the only evidence. Your alternative — escalation on the same ground — is also the outcome.

What the reviewer must settle. Obtain any recoverable driver-device or platform GPS export for 21:10:20–21:15:40 and determine whether the driver held position inside the 150 m radius for a continuous 300 seconds. If he did, the SGD 6.00 fee stands and the driver is owed 80% of it (SGD 4.80); if he did not, the fee is refunded in full under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 or POL-NS-06 as applicable. Two findings assist the packet. First, the fare line is sound: SGD 6.00 is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. Second, the chat log shows the driver replying within 120 seconds ('I am here beside the sign', 21:11:45, to the rider's 21:11:30 message), so POL-NS-04's rider-exoneration route is closed on the record as it stands.

Confidence and impairment. POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact. The driver's geofence position is carried only by EV-GPS-09109, at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so confidence is 0.0 and the 0.70 floor under POL-NS-09(a) is breached; POL-NS-09(e) independently engages because the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired. EV-ADVIS-09109-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is likewise MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact and no outcome relies on it. No clause produces a referral on these facts, so referrals is empty, and the open question above belongs to the reviewer rather than to a referral.

The driver's account is corroborated by the complete chat log, and the rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 is closed: the driver posted 'I am at the private-hire bay' at 21:10:40, twenty seconds after the arrival event, and when the rider wrote 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car' at 21:11:30 the driver replied 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45 — fifteen seconds later, well inside POL-NS-04's 120-second window — so limb (b) of that clause fails and the clause does not apply regardless of the reply's content.

POL-NS-05's false-arrival test cannot be run against the driver, and the rider carries the burden of it: the test matches the arrival timestamp to a GPS fix, and the only GPS artifact, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0. I disclose that impairment; no admissible fix places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or above, and a trace that does not exist cannot itself prove a false marker.
